decisions.title: The Alarm Clock Sits Outside the Agent Loop
decisions.description: Codex CLI has no scheduler — only codex exec. The App owns due-time matching. The loop never watches a clock; something outside drops a user message in when a job is due.
decisions.alternatives: Asking the model to remember to come back later would miss firings whenever no turn is running.

zh.title: 闹钟在 Agent loop 外面
zh.description: Codex CLI 没有调度器，只有 codex exec。到期判断在 App 里。loop 从不看表；外面的东西到点把一条用户消息塞进去。

decisions.title: cron Starts Fresh; heartbeat Resumes the Same Thread
decisions.description: kind=cron is a standalone run (new thread, findings to inbox/Triage), like one codex exec. kind=heartbeat appends the prompt to target_thread_id so old context stays. Those are the two drop-in styles in automation.toml.
decisions.alternatives: One 'just run the prompt' path would be simpler, but it cannot both isolate nightly jobs and babysit a live thread.

zh.title: cron 新开一轮，heartbeat 回到同一条 thread
zh.description: kind=cron 是独立运行（新 thread，发现进 inbox/Triage），像一次 codex exec。kind=heartbeat 把 prompt 追加到 target_thread_id，旧上下文还在。这就是 automation.toml 里的两种塞法。

decisions.title: A Queue Decouples Due Time from Execution
decisions.description: When a schedule matches, the scheduler only enqueues. A dispatcher pops when the agent is idle. Cron matching stays cheap; a long turn cannot stall the next tick.
decisions.alternatives: The scheduler could call the agent directly, but a slow job would stall the clock.

zh.title: 队列把到期判断和执行解耦
zh.description: 到期时调度器只入队。派发器在 Agent 空闲时再取。到期判断保持很便宜；一轮跑得久也不会卡住下一拍。
